user.title: Configure Activity Images
user.description: Select real calendars to monitor. New calendars default to disabled. Automatic generation is a separate paid opt-in. Settings apply without reload. Disabling auto prevents new attempts, not charges for a request already sent.

data.ai_task_entity_id: AI Task provider (optional for library-only mode)
data.auto_generate_calendar_entity_ids: Auto-generate missing images (select only monitored calendars)

confirm_auto.title: May incur AI charges
confirm_auto.description: Enable automatic missing-image generation for these calendars: {calendars}. The next automatic scan may send paid requests. Explicit rate-limit rejections may be retried up to three attempts. Provider-internal retries and charges are not controlled by this integration. Disabling later cannot cancel a request already sent.

data.confirm_paid: I authorize potentially paid automatic generation for these calendars

error.invalid_settings: Select at most 10 monitored calendars. Automatic calendars must be a subset and require an AI provider. Check the prompt, reference and trusted HTTP(S) Lucida URL.
